## 席位核对 · L1 (seat 3, L1-a) · 2026-11-17T09:46Z

L1: ACCEPT
Head-sha: 39afff86ac4bbc1e15376aeffb5f55933f2c6ce2
Card: #34707 · claim 6942530497 · os-dev-report 6943986387 (this head) · seat ruling A on the section nav (09:25Z, relayed by o3-B)

All three card items are built inside the claim's surface. No export and no i18n key are added, so the claim's `Clause-②: no` condition holds. Which fields show, their order and the Changed marks are unchanged. No must-fix and no should-fix.

### Must-fix

None.

### Should-fix

None.

### Readings that hold

| Item | Reading |
|:--|:--|
| PR shape | Draft, base `main`, `Closes #34707`, with no other closing verb. No `!` and no `(narrowing)`, so no dogfood battery is owed. |
| Scope | 4 files, +239/−7: `SubmittedRecord.tsx`, `submittedRecordPlan.ts` (carries `icon`), a new top-level `describe` in the shared harness `ApprovalDecisionPanel.fullRecord-34588.test.tsx`, and the changeset. All are under `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/approval-decision/**` plus `.changeset/`, as claimed. Nothing in `plugin-detail` or `components` is edited, only imported (`LazyIcon`, `type FormSectionNavItem`, both existing exports). The test goes in the existing shared file, not a card-named one, per ruling 6583487846 and AGENTS.md's shared-harness rule. |
| Base | Four commits on main `77b42a1e`, with no merge. Main has moved to `f6f5b50a`, and GitHub reports `mergeable_state: clean`. |
| (1) Heading face | `SectionHeading` is an `<h4>` under the card's `<h3>` "As submitted". Its classes are `DetailSection`'s frameless title row byte for byte (`flex min-h-11 sm:min-h-9 w-full … py-1.5 text-left text-[13px] font-semibold text-foreground`, over a `border-b border-border` hairline). `SectionIcon` repeats `DetailSection`'s `SectionIcon` (Lucide name through `LazyIcon`, otherwise text), with `aria-hidden` added on the text arm. The one difference is the label: `min-w-0 break-words` instead of `truncate`, for acceptance 3. Sections move from `space-y-4` to `space-y-6`, and a titled section's grid gets `pt-2.5`. `DetailSection` is the default record page's face (`useDefaultRecordPage() && !isPrintPage` picks frameless), so "the same style as the record page" holds for an object without a custom page. |
| (2) All open | There is no disclosure: `SectionHeading` is a plain heading, and a group declared `collapse: 'collapsed'` draws open. This is pinned (no `aria-expanded` control). The decision the card keeps is unchanged. |
| (3) Section links | `SectionNav` renders only with two or more titled sections. It is a `<nav aria-labelledby={headingId}>`, so its accessible name is the existing "As submitted" heading and no key is needed. It holds one `<button type="button">` per titled section in page order, calling `scrollIntoView({ block: 'start', behavior: 'smooth' })` on the heading, whose anchor id is `${useId()}-section-${i}` with `scroll-mt-3`. Seat ruling A keeps it module-internal, because plugin-form's `FormSectionNav` is not exported and exporting it would make this `Clause-②: yes`. The card says "可与 #34605 共用组件" ("may share"), so a second, smaller strip meets it. The strip does not stick, for the reason the PR measured (the page scroller's `p-3` band showed fields through above a stuck strip at 390px). |
| Unchanged rows | `planSubmittedRecord` only threads `icon` through, beside `label` and `columns`. The field filter, order and Changed / current value cells are untouched, and the pin compares each section's field keys, their order and the single Changed mark against before. The existing #34588 cases pass unedited. |
| Clause-② / Metadata-protocol | `no` / `none` in the claim, PR body and changeset. `SubmittedSectionInput` / `SubmittedSection` are module types of the private `@object-ui/app-shell` (`"private": true`), not exports from a published package. `fieldGroups[].icon` is an existing spec key that the record page already reads. |
| Changeset | `patch` on `@object-ui/app-shell` (private, so it versions without publishing; Check Changeset is green). Each sentence matches the diff, including "a group declared collapsed is not folded here" and "A record with one group shows no strip". |
| Tests | Real commands with output: 12 files / 136 tests over `approval-decision/` and its four importer / ratchet files, plus `type-check` (with `tsconfig.test.json`). Five new cases. Two ablations, each restored to the HEAD blob: a nav threshold of 1 turns 1 red (the one-section control), and the old muted label turns 4 red. The full app-shell suite was left to CI, as declared, and Test UI is green there. 38/38 derived gates, and the content-reading families were re-run on the final commit. |
| UI strings | None added. The nav reuses the card heading's name, and the icon is `aria-hidden`. |
| Docs | `ui/packages/app-shell/README.md`'s "The record, as submitted" paragraph describes the sections, the field filter and the Changed marks. It stays true and says nothing about the heading face or a nav. Nothing in `content/docs` or `skills` describes the card's section labels. |
| Acceptance | 1: titled groups read as headings in the record page's face (measured on the showcase approval page: 13px/600 foreground vs 11px/400 muted labels). 2: light and dark were both read (rgb(2,8,23) / rgb(248,250,252) headings vs rgb(100,116,139) / rgb(148,163,184) labels). 3: at 390px no heading is truncated and there is no sideways scroll. These were read on the showcase's two-group request, not on a HotCRM opportunity with 6+ groups. The face is per-section, so the count does not change the reading. |
| Tier | `check-governed-merges --pr 34743`: NOT governed, 246 lines. Tier S, lands through o3-B. |
| CI on this head | 51 check-runs: 38 `success`, 13 `skipped`, none failed or pending. That includes Test UI 9/9 planned shards plus the aggregate, Build & E2E UI, Live E2E UI, Type Check UI, Lint UI, every Type Check and Lint family, Check Changeset, PR-body guards and Governed Surface Queue Guard. |

### Notes

1. **"14px or larger" in the card.** The card's 现状 line reads the record page's titles as ≥14px in cards. The default record page today draws its frameless 13px face, and a 16px card face only off the default page or in print. The PR copies the default face, so the two pages match, and the PR body says so. If the maintainer meant the card face, that is a follow-up, not a defect here.
2. **Copied classes can drift.** `SectionHeading` / `SectionIcon` repeat `DetailSection`'s strings because that component does not export its header. A later change to the record page's section face will not reach this card on its own. No pin compares the two. A shared header export (Clause-② yes) is the lasting fix, and it is the same trade the seat ruled on for the nav.
3. **Out of scope, reported by the PR:** at 390px the record page's absolutely positioned `ManagedByBadge` overlaps the card's "Open record" link. It predates this PR and is the seat's to file.
